author: NASA / ISS Expedition 30 crew
why: Actual astronaut photograph of Mauritania's Richat Structure, captured with a Nikon D2Xs and 400 mm lens. Recognizable concentric rings suit a near-square card; source offers a 2.78 MB JPEG but does not state pixel dimensions.

why: Real Nikon D5 astronaut photograph showing the Richat Structure surrounded by extensive Saharan dune fields. Broader landscape alternative; source offers a 5.21 MB JPEG but does not state pixel dimensions.
